sections.title: Income tax on salaries: monthly scale

source.title: ກົດໝາຍວ່າດ້ວຍ ອາກອນລາຍໄດ້ (ສະບັບປັບປຸງ) ເລກທີ 88/ສພຊ (Law on Income Tax, amended, No. 88/NA)

sections.basis: monthly salaries, wages, overtime, position and other allowances, bonuses, board fees and other benefits of residents (Article 33(1)); the band limits follow the minimum wage set by the Government from time to time

sections.title: Income tax on salaries: annual reconciliation scale

source.title: ກົດໝາຍວ່າດ້ວຍ ອາກອນລາຍໄດ້ (ສະບັບປັບປຸງ) ເລກທີ 88/ສພຊ (Law on Income Tax, amended, No. 88/NA)

sections.basis: annual reconciliation of the income tax on salaries; the year's income and tax paid are declared by 31 March of the following year (Article 50)

rows.label: Exemption: income up to the minimum wage
rows.value: Salaries and other income up to the minimum wage set by the Government are exempt from income tax (Article 34(1)).

source.title: ກົດໝາຍວ່າດ້ວຍ ອາກອນລາຍໄດ້ (ສະບັບປັບປຸງ) ເລກທີ 88/ສພຊ (Law on Income Tax, amended, No. 88/NA)

rows.label: Deduction for dependants (per person, at most three)
rows.note: deduction from annual income for each dependant without income in the household register (parents, spouse, children under 18, persons without legal capacity), at most three persons (Article 51).

source.title: ກົດໝາຍວ່າດ້ວຍ ອາກອນລາຍໄດ້ (ສະບັບປັບປຸງ) ເລກທີ 88/ສພຊ (Law on Income Tax, amended, No. 88/NA)

rows.label: Lottery winnings and prizes: 5%
rows.note: lottery winnings above LAK 10 million and gifts or prizes above LAK 5 million, on the gross amount (Article 38(4.1) and (4.2)).

source.title: ກົດໝາຍວ່າດ້ວຍ ອາກອນລາຍໄດ້ (ສະບັບປັບປຸງ) ເລກທີ 88/ສພຊ (Law on Income Tax, amended, No. 88/NA)
ກົດໝາຍວ່າດ້ວຍ ອາກອນລາຍໄດ້ (ສະບັບປັບປຸງ) ເລກທີ 88/ສພຊ (Law on Income Tax, amended, No. 88/NA)

rows.label: Monthly withholding on salaries: payment by the 20th
rows.value: Employers withhold income tax from salaries and pay it to the tax office by the 20th of the following month, issuing a withholding certificate to the employee (Article 39).

source.title: ກົດໝາຍວ່າດ້ວຍ ອາກອນລາຍໄດ້ (ສະບັບປັບປຸງ) ເລກທີ 88/ສພຊ (Law on Income Tax, amended, No. 88/NA)
ກົດໝາຍວ່າດ້ວຍ ອາກອນລາຍໄດ້ (ສະບັບປັບປຸງ) ເລກທີ 88/ສພຊ (Law on Income Tax, amended, No. 88/NA)

rows.label: Non-residents: employment income at the progressive rates (0% to 25%)
rows.value: Non-residents pay income tax on salaries, wages, allowances, bonuses and board fees at the progressive rates of 0% to 25% (Article 48(1)); the payer withholds and pays the tax within 15 days (Article 49).

source.title: ກົດໝາຍວ່າດ້ວຍ ອາກອນລາຍໄດ້ (ສະບັບປັບປຸງ) ເລກທີ 88/ສພຊ (Law on Income Tax, amended, No. 88/NA)
ກົດໝາຍວ່າດ້ວຍ ອາກອນລາຍໄດ້ (ສະບັບປັບປຸງ) ເລກທີ 88/ສພຊ (Law on Income Tax, amended, No. 88/NA)

rows.label: Rental income: 10% of gross rent
rows.note: rental income from land, houses, buildings, vehicles, machinery and other assets, on the gross rent (Article 38(5.3)); declared within 15 days of receipt, or withheld by business tenants (Article 41).

source.title: ກົດໝາຍວ່າດ້ວຍ ອາກອນລາຍໄດ້ (ສະບັບປັບປຸງ) ເລກທີ 88/ສພຊ (Law on Income Tax, amended, No. 88/NA)
ກົດໝາຍວ່າດ້ວຍ ອາກອນລາຍໄດ້ (ສະບັບປັບປຸງ) ເລກທີ 88/ສພຊ (Law on Income Tax, amended, No. 88/NA)

rows.label: Non-residents: 2% on sales and transfers of shares
rows.note: non-residents: sale, handover or transfer of shares, on the gross amount (Article 48(4)).

source.title: ກົດໝາຍວ່າດ້ວຍ ອາກອນລາຍໄດ້ (ສະບັບປັບປຸງ) ເລກທີ 88/ສພຊ (Law on Income Tax, amended, No. 88/NA)

rows.label: Sales and transfers of shares: 2% of the gross amount
rows.note: sale or transfer of shares by individuals or legal entities, on the gross amount (Article 38(3.1)).

source.title: ກົດໝາຍວ່າດ້ວຍ ອາກອນລາຍໄດ້ (ສະບັບປັບປຸງ) ເລກທີ 88/ສພຊ (Law on Income Tax, amended, No. 88/NA)

rows.label: Sales and transfers of land use rights and buildings: 2% of the gross amount
rows.note: income tax on the sale or transfer of land use rights, houses and buildings, on the gross amount (Article 38(3.2)); agricultural land for farming 1%.

source.title: ກົດໝາຍວ່າດ້ວຍ ອາກອນລາຍໄດ້ (ສະບັບປັບປຸງ) ເລກທີ 88/ສພຊ (Law on Income Tax, amended, No. 88/NA)

rows.label: Sales and transfers of agricultural land: 1% of the gross amount
rows.note: sale or transfer of agricultural land use rights for agricultural production, on the gross amount (Article 38(2)).

source.title: ກົດໝາຍວ່າດ້ວຍ ອາກອນລາຍໄດ້ (ສະບັບປັບປຸງ) ເລກທີ 88/ສພຊ (Law on Income Tax, amended, No. 88/NA)
ກົດໝາຍວ່າດ້ວຍ ອາກອນລາຍໄດ້ (ສະບັບປັບປຸງ) ເລກທີ 88/ສພຊ (Law on Income Tax, amended, No. 88/NA)

sections.title: Dividends, interest and payments to non-residents

rows.label: Non-residents: 10% on dividends, interest, rents, commissions and service fees
rows.note: non-residents, on gross income: fees of committees, artists and athletes; dividends and interest; sales and rentals of vehicles, buildings, machinery and other assets; commissions, consulting and service fees (Article 48(2)).

source.title: ກົດໝາຍວ່າດ້ວຍ ອາກອນລາຍໄດ້ (ສະບັບປັບປຸງ) ເລກທີ 88/ສພຊ (Law on Income Tax, amended, No. 88/NA)

rows.label: Non-residents: 5% on royalties, teaching and research fees and lottery winnings
rows.note: non-residents, on gross income: teachers and researchers; copyright, patent and trademark fees; lottery winnings above LAK 10 million (Article 48(3)).

source.title: ກົດໝາຍວ່າດ້ວຍ ອາກອນລາຍໄດ້ (ສະບັບປັບປຸງ) ເລກທີ 88/ສພຊ (Law on Income Tax, amended, No. 88/NA)

rows.label: Royalties and other intellectual property income: 5%
rows.note: income from intellectual property (copyrights, patents, trademarks and other rights), on the gross amount (Article 38(4.3)).

source.title: ກົດໝາຍວ່າດ້ວຍ ອາກອນລາຍໄດ້ (ສະບັບປັບປຸງ) ເລກທີ 88/ສພຊ (Law on Income Tax, amended, No. 88/NA)

rows.label: Dividends: 10%
rows.note: dividends and other profit distributions to shareholders, on the gross amount (Article 38(5.1)); the company pays the tax within 15 days (Article 40).

source.title: ກົດໝາຍວ່າດ້ວຍ ອາກອນລາຍໄດ້ (ສະບັບປັບປຸງ) ເລກທີ 88/ສພຊ (Law on Income Tax, amended, No. 88/NA)

rows.label: Interest on loans outside the banking system and guarantee fees: 10%
rows.note: interest on loans not made through banks or non-bank financial institutions, and guarantee income (Article 38(5.2)).

source.title: ກົດໝາຍວ່າດ້ວຍ ອາກອນລາຍໄດ້ (ສະບັບປັບປຸງ) ເລກທີ 88/ສພຊ (Law on Income Tax, amended, No. 88/NA)
ກົດໝາຍວ່າດ້ວຍ ອາກອນລາຍໄດ້ (ສະບັບປັບປຸງ) ເລກທີ 88/ສພຊ (Law on Income Tax, amended, No. 88/NA)

sections.title: Social insurance contributions

rows.label: Social security: employer contribution (enterprises)
rows.note: employer contribution for each worker, on insured pay (basic salary, piece-rate pay, overtime and other taxable pay) between the minimum wage and the insured-pay ceiling (Article 74(2.1)); paid monthly with the workers' share (Article 75).

source.title: ກົດໝາຍວ່າດ້ວຍ ການປະກັນສັງຄົມ (ສະບັບປັບປຸງ) ເລກທີ 54/ສພຊ (Law on Social Security, amended, No. 54/NA)

rows.label: Social security: employee contribution (enterprises)
rows.note: worker contribution, on the same insured pay between the minimum wage and the ceiling (Article 74(2.2)).

source.title: ກົດໝາຍວ່າດ້ວຍ ການປະກັນສັງຄົມ (ສະບັບປັບປຸງ) ເລກທີ 54/ສພຊ (Law on Social Security, amended, No. 54/NA)

rows.label: Social security: State contribution (public sector)
rows.note: State contribution for civil servants, soldiers and police, on the payroll (Article 74(1.1)).

source.title: ກົດໝາຍວ່າດ້ວຍ ການປະກັນສັງຄົມ (ສະບັບປັບປຸງ) ເລກທີ 54/ສພຊ (Law on Social Security, amended, No. 54/NA)

rows.label: Social security: civil servants, soldiers and police
rows.note: civil servants, soldiers and police, on insured pay (Article 74(1.2)).

source.title: ກົດໝາຍວ່າດ້ວຍ ການປະກັນສັງຄົມ (ສະບັບປັບປຸງ) ເລກທີ 54/ສພຊ (Law on Social Security, amended, No. 54/NA)
ກົດໝາຍວ່າດ້ວຍ ການປະກັນສັງຄົມ (ສະບັບປັບປຸງ) ເລກທີ 54/ສພຊ (Law on Social Security, amended, No. 54/NA)

sections.note: Employee and employer shares, contribution floors and caps; each row says who pays and on what base.

rows.label: Profit tax: standard rate
rows.note: profit tax on enterprises (Article 15).

source.title: ກົດໝາຍວ່າດ້ວຍ ອາກອນລາຍໄດ້ (ສະບັບປັບປຸງ) ເລກທີ 88/ສພຊ (Law on Income Tax, amended, No. 88/NA)

rows.label: Domestic minimum profit tax for multinational groups (15% effective rate)
rows.note: members of multinational groups whose effective tax rate under international rules is below 15% pay a domestic minimum profit tax up to that rate (Article 15).

source.title: ກົດໝາຍວ່າດ້ວຍ ອາກອນລາຍໄດ້ (ສະບັບປັບປຸງ) ເລກທີ 88/ສພຊ (Law on Income Tax, amended, No. 88/NA)

rows.label: Profit tax: tobacco enterprises
rows.note: enterprises producing, importing and selling tobacco products; 2 points go to the Tobacco Control Fund (Article 16(1.1)).

source.title: ກົດໝາຍວ່າດ້ວຍ ອາກອນລາຍໄດ້ (ສະບັບປັບປຸງ) ເລກທີ 88/ສພຊ (Law on Income Tax, amended, No. 88/NA)

rows.label: Profit tax: alcoholic drinks enterprises
rows.note: enterprises producing, importing and selling alcoholic drinks; 2 points go to the Health Insurance Fund (Article 16(1.2)).

source.title: ກົດໝາຍວ່າດ້ວຍ ອາກອນລາຍໄດ້ (ສະບັບປັບປຸງ) ເລກທີ 88/ສພຊ (Law on Income Tax, amended, No. 88/NA)

rows.label: Profit tax: casinos
rows.note: casino businesses (Article 16(1.3)).

source.title: ກົດໝາຍວ່າດ້ວຍ ອາກອນລາຍໄດ້ (ສະບັບປັບປຸງ) ເລກທີ 88/ສພຊ (Law on Income Tax, amended, No. 88/NA)

rows.label: Profit tax: mining concessions and mineral exporters
rows.note: mining concessions and mineral exporters (Article 16(1.4)).

source.title: ກົດໝາຍວ່າດ້ວຍ ອາກອນລາຍໄດ້ (ສະບັບປັບປຸງ) ເລກທີ 88/ສພຊ (Law on Income Tax, amended, No. 88/NA)

rows.label: Reduced profit tax: innovation, hospitals and medicines (after the tax holiday)
rows.note: businesses in innovation research, modern hospitals, pharmaceutical and medical-equipment factories and traditional medicine, after their profit tax holiday under the Investment Promotion Law (Article 16(2.1)).

source.title: ກົດໝາຍວ່າດ້ວຍ ອາກອນລາຍໄດ້ (ສະບັບປັບປຸງ) ເລກທີ 88/ສພຊ (Law on Income Tax, amended, No. 88/NA)

rows.label: Reduced profit tax: green and clean-energy technology (after the tax holiday)
rows.note: businesses using innovative, environment-friendly, resource-saving and clean-energy technology in production, after their profit tax holiday (Article 16(2.2)).

source.title: ກົດໝາຍວ່າດ້ວຍ ອາກອນລາຍໄດ້ (ສະບັບປັບປຸງ) ເລກທີ 88/ສພຊ (Law on Income Tax, amended, No. 88/NA)

rows.label: Reduced profit tax: listed companies (first ten years)
rows.note: companies listed on the stock exchange, for ten years from listing (Article 16(2.3)).

source.title: ກົດໝາຍວ່າດ້ວຍ ອາກອນລາຍໄດ້ (ສະບັບປັບປຸງ) ເລກທີ 88/ສພຊ (Law on Income Tax, amended, No. 88/NA)
ກົດໝາຍວ່າດ້ວຍ ອາກອນລາຍໄດ້ (ສະບັບປັບປຸງ) ເລກທີ 88/ສພຊ (Law on Income Tax, amended, No. 88/NA)

rows.label: VAT standard rate
rows.note: imports of goods, supplies of goods and services taxed in the Lao PDR, and purchases from foreign entities without an enterprise in the Lao PDR (Article 17(1)).

source.title: ກົດໝາຍວ່າດ້ວຍ ອາກອນມູນຄ່າເພີ່ມ (ສະບັບປັບປຸງ) ເລກທີ 60/ສພຊ (Law on Value Added Tax, amended, No. 60/NA)

rows.label: VAT zero rate: exports and supplies into economic zones
rows.note: exports of goods abroad and into special and specific economic zones, including finished mineral products (Article 17(2)).

source.title: ກົດໝາຍວ່າດ້ວຍ ອາກອນມູນຄ່າເພີ່ມ (ສະບັບປັບປຸງ) ເລກທີ 60/ສພຊ (Law on Value Added Tax, amended, No. 60/NA)

rows.label: VAT registration: all registered enterprises
rows.value: Every person or entity that has registered an enterprise, holds a taxpayer identification number and a business licence must enter the VAT system; the law sets no turnover threshold (Article 33). VAT is paid monthly by the 20th of the following month (Article 31).

source.title: ກົດໝາຍວ່າດ້ວຍ ອາກອນມູນຄ່າເພີ່ມ (ສະບັບປັບປຸງ) ເລກທີ 60/ສພຊ (Law on Value Added Tax, amended, No. 60/NA)

rows.note: beer above 5% alcohol.

rows.label: Deemed profit margins for businesses without proper accounts
rows.value: Businesses without proper accounts, and non-residents without an establishment in Laos, pay profit tax on deemed profit: turnover × 7% (agriculture and handicrafts), 10% (industry), 15% (trade and services) or 30% (suppliers to electricity and mining), then the profit tax rate (Article 14).
